behavior: World-owned, read-only NPC runtime inspection exposes stable exact-instance and filtered snapshots of identity, lifecycle, room ownership, HP, respawn state, target, pending action, claim, threat ledger and movement state without mutating runtime state.
safe_fallback: Unknown instance IDs return null; malformed threat-ledger JSON is exposed as an empty ledger and does not mutate persisted data.
runtime_impact: Adds deterministic administrative and diagnostic inspection over existing world-owned NPC state.
